card.title: Playstation 3 Error 8002F1F9

claims.statement: PS3 Slim/Super Slim error 8002F1F9 means the Wi-Fi/BT module isn't detected, usually because the always-on 1.8 V switching regulator overheated and failed (sometimes shorting 5 V onto 1.8 V).
With the console in standby the regulator needs 5 V and 3.3 V inputs and should output 1.8 V at its coil.
Fix: replace with a compatible 6-WDFN regulator (e.g. RT8057) or, more reliably, install an AMS1117-1.8 LDO (CECH-30xx also needs a 10 nF 6.3 V MLCC); confirm 1.8 V on its middle pin.

procedure: Measure regulator 5 V and 3.3 V inputs and 1.8 V output (standby).
Fit RT8057 or AMS1117-1.8 (+10 nF on CECH-30xx).
Verify 1.8 V; test update, Bluetooth pairing and Wi-Fi.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
